title: Month 1 · the world's turn
headline: The tower ends Month 1 with 185 GP, 15 short of Farms, and the Goblinkind have marched two Militia into B2, right next door, on their way to take people from A3.

plan: Morten delved floor 1 under the tower: the safe start, 300 XP and 25 GP with no travel.
He deposited 75 GP (the floor's coins and his purse) and kept 2 SP 5 CP.
The tower took no action: 175 GP after the deposit, 185 GP after A3's 10 GP income, and everything costs 200 GP.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Goblinkind (bad: takes people for soldiers) marched two Militia from their seat B1 into B2, the Tieflings' forest beside the tower. Their goal is to take people from A3, so this is aimed straight at us; next they need to step into A3 itself.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The second Militia came with it: two Militia, 4 HP each, attacking with Force 4 against the tower's Force 1.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Humans (bad: takes land) sent their Thugs and Beast pack from B4 into the Orcs' A5, after the land there; it leaves their seat B4 with no soldiers in it, two hexes south of us.

happened.label: good
happened.text: Our ally the Elves (good: fights tyrants) bought Farms in their seat C1 and finished their goal.

domain.elsewhere: The Gnomes moved Thugs into D3 toward the Humans' C3, and the Orcs moved Militia into the Gnomes' D4. Two hidden Cunning moves; the Goblinkind regime is down to 18/22 HP from something the tower didn't see.

threats: the Goblinkind's two Militia in B2 are one move from A3. Once in A3 they can attack the tower's seat (it has no soldiers), d10 + 4 against d10 + 1 for 1d6 HP each; at 0 HP the tower is sacked and loses half its treasury.
chances: the Militia themselves are a Low fight each (Guards, Scouts, a Guard Captain) once they're in reach; a Strike does 2d6 to one, but makes the Goblinkind hostile for 3 months.
the Humans' seat B4 and the Goblinkind's seat B1 have no soldiers at home (a Strike does 2d6 to the regime).
open: the tower has 185 GP and +10 GP a month; one more good delve pays for Farms (200 GP) or Thugs to guard the seat (200 GP).
floor 2 is under the Orcs' D5 (4 days); the closer floors are deep: floor 8 in A2, 11 in B2, 13 in A4.

log: Morten: Delve floor 1 under A3 (the dungeon game; no domain effect).
Order: Goblinkind C4 (d10 10) · Tieflings C4 (d10 8) · Gnomes C4 (d10 5) · Orcs C4 (d10 4) · Humans C3 (d10 3) · Elves C2 (d10 6) · Tower C1 (d10 1).
Goblinkind (Overlord Zarga, bad: takes people for soldiers): Move Militia a5 B1 → B2, Militia a6 B1 → B2 (goal: take people from the tower's seat in A3).
Gnomes (Tinker-General Orryn, bad: takes land): Move Thugs a14 D4 → D3 (goal: take C3 (L9, Humans')).
Orcs (Chief Ozgar, bad: takes land): Move Militia a22 D5 → D4 (goal: take D4 (L17, Gnomes')).
Humans (Marshal Aldric, bad: takes land): Move Thugs a1 B4 → A5, Beast pack a2 B4 → A5 (goal: take A5 (L15, Orcs')).
Elves (Archon Eilistra, good: fights tyrants): Buy Farms a25 in C1 (goal: buy Farms), −200 GP → 340 GP.
Elves (Archon Eilistra, good: fights tyrants): goal done (buy Farms): +1 XP (1).
